existing_plugin_coverage: None found; this is a repository-specific, automated test-generation workflow pattern not covered by eslint-plugin-jest or other published rules, which generally do not model 'this file's documented testing scope' as a lint target.
likely_false_positives: A barrel test file without an explicit 'shape-only, no duplication' scope comment is not a violation; adding the first behavioral test for a function that has no dedicated module test file elsewhere is legitimate and should not be flagged.
mechanical_correction: When adding coverage for a function, first check whether it already has a behavioral test file for its defining module (e.g. via existing `<module>.test.ts` or `<module>-host-config.test.ts` conventions) before adding assertions to a barrel/re-export test file. If the barrel file's header comment states it checks re-export shape only, confine additions there to `typeof x === 'function'`-style shape checks and add real behavioral assertions to the defining module's own test file instead.

syntactic_constructs: describe('<reexportedFunctionName> via barrel', ...) added inside a *.test.ts file whose header comment documents barrel-shape-only testing scope
behavioral expect(...).toEqual(...)/toThrow(...) assertions on a re-exported function inside a re-export smoke-test suite
unsafe_pattern: Adding behavioral/table-driven assertions for a re-exported function's actual logic (e.g. parseDifcProxyHost host/port parsing, scheme stripping, IPv6 handling, invalid-port errors; filterCapDrop capability bounding-set filtering) directly into a barrel re-export smoke-test file such as src/docker-manager.test.ts, whose file-header comment states it verifies only that the barrel 're-exports every expected symbol and that each symbol has the expected shape (function)...without duplicating the underlying module tests.' The real function already has a dedicated, more complete behavioral suite elsewhere (src/docker-manager-host-config.test.ts for parseDifcProxyHost; src/capability-filter.ts's own test file for filterCapDrop).
